notes.title: Introducing Mod Support (beta)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/3bb66f68f0b6a1380a8e05f0434e36cf4d54256c.png[/img]

After testing our ModKit in the experimental branch for several weeks, we've now enabled Mods in Dystopika's public branch. We are ready to open the floodgates for custom districts, buildings, props, and holograms via Steam Workshop. 

[h1]Release Notes v1.3.1[/h1]
[h2]Mod Support (Beta)[/h2]
Dystopika now supports custom content created with our ModKit. Mods can be distributed via Steam Workshop, or by placing any modification packages into the new Mods folder (see [i]City Save Editor[/i] below).

Mod Support is still considered “Beta” and may have unexpected behaviors. We continue to track bugs and improve workflow for the Dystopika ModKit. Please stop by the [b]#dys_modding[/b] channel in the [url=http://discord.voidswithin.com/]Discord[/url] to get help or request features.

If you’d like to learn more about making mods for Dystopika, please visit  [url=http://modding.voidswithin.com]http://modding.voidswithin.com[/url]. We are continuing to add documentation and tutorials. 

[h2]City Save Editor[/h2]
With Mod support, there is a new interface for creating cities that allows for enabling and selecting mods, as well as quick shortcuts to the Steam Workshop and Mods folder.

This same screen allows you to enable/edit mods for old cities, and to quickly access world seeds or rename cities without needing to Load the City. 

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] A duplicate save button has been added to the Load City screen
[*] An indicator has been added to indicate the currently open city on the Load City screen
[*] Green “error blocks” will now appear in-game where content has failed to load, e.g. if a mod is missing.
[*] Added an Intensity slider to Advanced Prop menu for Hologram emitters to control brightness
[*] Added a “Legacy Screenshot Mode” toggle to use the old screenshot method at the expense of less accurate fog rendering.
[/list]

[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various visual improvements to the Load City screen
[*] Loading up the game will now reload the last opened city (previously opened last SAVED city)
[*] Experimental Mode notification now only displays in Pause Menu
[*] Building previews now support multiple materials and meshes in preparation for mod support
[*] Resolution scale setting is now maxed at 1.5. 
[*] Made some adjustments to Fog Quality at Ultra quality for better performance.
[*] Increased the horizontal size of the District selection menu to accommodate longer names.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some buildings could not be height adjusted.
[*] Fixed a bug where Props were being improperly positioned near the city border.
[*] Fixed some visual elements not being included in unlock transitions.
[*] Fixed some visual effects not triggered on some props and bridges.
[*] Fixed a bug where widescreen resolution screenshots were being clamped to 4k.
[*] Fixed a bug where Props unlock progress was not being cleared when resetting the player profile.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing holograms on an emitter would change the wrong emitter.
[*] Fixed a bug where "Angled Top" CBD building had a chance of breaking game input. 
[/list]

notes.title: A Roadmap Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/f19e41fe5a5737ecf584b165a1bc4b4291801eed.gif[/img]

Hey everyone! I wanted to share an update to Dystopika's post-launch roadmap. 

Firstly, [b]Mod Support[/b] is being prioritized over the planned Photo Mode enhancements. This will be a big project, but I feel will be more exciting for the community. 

There is demand for so many new buildings, props, and districts that it is far bigger than anything I could make on my own, so I want to put that into modders hands as soon as possible. 

Secondly, I'm adjusting the release cadence. Packing many new features developed over several weeks into a single release created a lot of friction in the testing. 

As a result, I've re-organized the roadmap into approximate timelines rather than grouping by version number. I'd like to return to smaller but more frequent, focused updates where small features can ship when they are ready instead of waiting on being bundled with a "big update". 

I'm really excited about these changes and some of the work happening behind-the-scenes right now (like dynamic sky). 

As always, I'm grateful as hell to this community, the things you create, and the kindness you have shown me and each other. 

Let's keep this update train rolling!
[b]Matt[/b]

notes.title: v1.1.1 Now Available
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! 

Happy (Canadian) Thanksgiving! A small(ish) update here, primarily aimed at bug fixes and quality of life improvements related to v1.1 feedback. 

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Norsk language now available
[*] Fog shadowing has been added to maximize sunset 𝕍𝕀𝔹𝔼𝕊.
[*] Whale hologram has been recentered to the emitter and motion adjusted for better consistency in preparation for future functionality
[*] Noto Sans Devanagari and Noto Emoji are now part of the Neon Sign fallback font library. 😈🚀🍕
[*] Made some adjustments to the rain particle system to improve look and performance
[*] Pause menu news updates from Steam will now prioritize certain updates
[*] Adjusted some props to allow for more versatile placement
[/list]
[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolution/Vsync settings have reworked to better demonstrate the functionality relating to framerate
[*] Fullscreen windowed mode has been added
[*] Target FPS slider has been added, activated when Vsync is set to off, and also reflects how Vsync limits framerate at different settings
[*] Closed Loop road setting has been moved to the Advanced Prop panel (no more right click)
[*] When playing on the Experimental Branch, “Experimental Mode”, will now be visible on the screen. 
[*] Bulk Backup restore buttons now activate in Experimental mode. 
[*] Experimental Mode saves are now separate from main branch saves and progress is tracked separately. This prevents accidental corruption of saves when moving back and forth between main and experimental. I continue to stress: THINGS MAY BREAK IN EXPERIMENTAL and your saves may be lost
[*] Removed achievement progress from Experimental mode
[*] Increased distance threshold to initiate right click on billboard to change image (prevent accidental clicks) 
[*] Decreased height of selectable area on roads to make it easier to select curve control points. 
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Closed Loop roads did not save properly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Weather state to not save
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a break in the Monorail track geometry
[*] Fixed a bug that caused rain to be more performance intensive that it needed to be. 
[*] Fixed a bug where traffic density would not update all parts of the road
[*] Fixed incorrect texture filtering on traffic
[*] Fixed Vsync count not saving with resolution settings
[*] Fixed an issue causing stuttering when rendering UI with Thai characters
[*] Fixed an issue where buildings could not be moved if placed inside a Prop
[/list]
[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Display settings may need to be reset to reflect new modes and values
[*] Display settings only show available resolutions and refresh rate for current mode. Options may change when switching between Display Modes (e.g. Fullscreen to Windowed) 
[*] Some prop placements generate incorrect rotations
[/list]
[h1]What's Next[/h1]
The Roadmap is currently being adjusted to prioritize the introduction of Mod Support before Photo Mode improvements along with other community suggestions. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Dystopika v1.1 now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The wait is over and I'm happy to unleash [b]Dystopika 1.1[/b]. This update ended up having much more than originally planned and I'm excited to see what you will create.

For a quick rundown of the new features, I'd like to turn things over to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@delindsay]DeLindsay Gaming[/url], who compiled this excellent overview during the update's private beta phase alongside his usual work unlocking the extraordinary things that can be done with Dystopika. 

[previewyoutube=6DcTlB_i7fk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
The next update, [b]v1.2[/b], is dedicated to [b]Photo Mode[/b] and improving not only how you capture your creations but also bringing several photo mode settings into your city settings for a whole slew of new city-building vibes.

Expect new tools for plotting camera movements, improved camera controls, being able to save presets, and likely a few more surprises. 

I'm also looking ahead to [b]1.3[/b] where I will start unlocking modding possibilities. 

[h1]Release Notes[/h1]

[h2]What's New[/h2]
[h3]Highways & Monorails[/h3]
There are three types of new Transportation-themed props: Small Roads, Wide Roads, and Monorails. These props are controllable curves that can be placed anywhere on the map and height adjusted with five control points. 

When close to the ground, these new types will clear away any low-lying density to prevent awkward building collisions. 

[h3]New Buildings & Props[/h3]
6 new buildings (with 2 height variants) have been added to the existing districts. New props include the aforementioned Transportation paths as well as satellite dishes, mounted signs, and more. 

While this is a small content update for buildings, there have been significant changes to props to set better foundations for future mod support, primarily in the form of...

[h3]Advanced Prop Controls[/h3]
Props now have a series of advanced controls to modify size, rotation, and other settings based on the specific prop. Press TAB to bring up the Advanced Controls panel to explore what you can do. 

See Quality of Life updates for what's new with existing props. 

[h3]New Languages[/h3]
French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Thai, Indonesian, and Russian has been added to the game. 

Achievements are now translated as well. 

I am also now opening up our translation project on CrowdIn to the public to contribute to additional languages or improve the existing translations. Join our Discord to learn more about contributing in the #dys_translations channel.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[h3]Updated Clone Tool[/h3]
This was a secret debug tool which has now been polished and improved.

Before moving a building hold ALT to clone the highlighted building. Any attached props will be cloned as well. 

[h3]Control Tips[/h3]
To better expose the Clone Tool above and other more secretive power tools (like Light Brush size), there are now context-aware control tips in the lower left. They can be disabled in the settings. 

[h3]Unified Billboards[/h3]
Billboards are now represented just by their aspect ratio in the Prop menu, and can be resized with Advanced Controls (TAB) to be tiny or massive. 

The Custom Media button has also been relocated to the Advanced Controls menu where there is also a HEX colour and brightness control. 

[b]Billboards from your old saves should still work, but there may be slight color/brightness shifts due to the new color and brightness controls.[/b]

[h3]Unified Text Tool[/h3]
Similar to Unified Billboards, the Text props have been unified to a single prop with Advanced Controls (TAB) to set size, orientation, and colour. 

[h3]Air Traffic Control[/h3]
In City Settings you can now control how much Air Traffic your city has - or turn it off completely. 

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed Unity splash screen
[*] Removed Grid Snapping toggle. Replaced by the control tips but buildings can still be snapped with CTRL.
[*] Steam News now displays in the Pause Menu
[*] Load City screen will now show the current city in the list of save files and a non-interactable item
[*] Safe Mode now has a persistent UI reminder
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Save Files are written to a temp file first to prevent loss of save due to a crash
[*] Additional Memory optimizations have been made to the Undo/Redo stack
[*] Improved some prop positioning constraint logic
[*] Fixed several non game-breaking writable geometry/collision errors
[*] Fixed a bug where deprecated props were accessible in the random prop selector. 
[*] Tooltips now forced to stay on the screen
[*] Fixed a bug where some operations would be cancelled when mouse is hovered on the Toolbar
[*] Fixed a bug where tutorials and progress could not be saved.
[*] Prevented ENTER from spawning UI element duplicates
[*] Fixed some rotation errors related to prop placement
[/list]

notes.title: An Update on 1.1
notes.content:
Hello friends, I may have cooked too much. 

1.1 has become bigger than I had originally planned and it needs just a little more time to simmer. 

However, I think you will be very happy with the expanded 1.1 update which now includes new content on top of the planned Quality of Life updates for billboards, custom neons, flying traffic, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/00b518d63144511909b49c6e47f3462df163344e.gif[/img]

[h2]Highways[/h2]
The [url=https://discord.gg/3Zt5YEywZn]Discord[/url] [i]Road Warriors[/i] have been heard loud and clear and [b]highways are coming to Dystopika 1.1[/b]. Highways can be adjusted to create the bends and curves your dystopian heart desires. You can make roads span the full city or make them weave and duck through each other like a giant web. They are also height-adjustable to make skyways or some Rollercoaster Tycoon-inspired insanity. You can also adjust traffic density and there will be multiple road styles. 

[h2]New Buildings and Props[/h2]
Each district is getting new building types alongside several new props. New creative possibilities! More teases of the new content over the coming weeks. 

[h2]Community Creation Challenges[/h2]

notes.title: Dystopika v1.0.5 now available
notes.content:
Hello everyone. There will be some news on 1.1 coming soon but in the meantime, I'm happy to release v1.0.5 which introduces Safe Mode as well as some under-the-hood changes to how saves are handled that will benefit those who play Dystopika across multiple devices.

Yes, I skipped v1.0.4. I attended the Microsoft Windows School of Counting. 

[h1]Release Notes - v1.0.5[/h1]

[h2]What's New[/h2]
[h3]Safe Mode[/h3]

Safe Mode will skip loading custom billboard media (and show a broken image in its place). The custom media is still "linked" and will reappear the next time you open outside safe mode, but with Safe Mode you can remove or replace billboards if you exceed your system memory. In short, you can attempt to bring a city back under memory requirements in the event of a crash. 

Safe Mode also disables Save on Exit and adds a warning when you are about to save.

Safe Mode also exposes [b]Bulk City Import and Export options[/b] in the Pause Menu, which allows you to backup all of your cities and import accordingly. Great for when you want to hop onto the experimental branch without affecting your saves.

To enter Safe Mode, [b]press F8[/b] during the intro message, or use the console command [b]safe-mode[/b].

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] If Custom Media billboard cannot be found, it will display a blue Broken Image billboard instead of a random billboard which was the old behaviour. The path to the media will be retained unless the billboard is manually changed or deleted. This is helpful if you use a Steam Deck and don’t want to break your saves that use Custom Media (which doesn’t move with your city). 
[*] Last Opened City is now saved LOCALLY and will not be synced. This prevents unintentionally opening a city on another device (like a Steam Deck) which may not be desired.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prop placement having unexpected results when placed on buildings near the world border (i.e. strange rotation behaviour)
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented prop unlocks from saving.
[*] Fixed some bugs that would prevent the game from soft locking due to loading corrupted saves.
[/list]

[h2]A Note on Translations[/h2]
Some newer features, buttons, and modals are missing edge case translations and will default back to English right now. There is a larger translation project happening behind-the-scenes where I am changing the workflow to make it easier to continuously improve translations as I add features. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Dystopika v1.0.1 now available
notes.content:
Wow. Just [b]wow[/b]. 

Thank you so much for your reviews, your kindness, your Tweets, and enjoying this weird little thing I made. It's unexpected, it's overwhelming, it's [i]amazing[/i]. I love this freaky little project and I can't wait to realize some wild places I want to take it. 

I tried to address some of the most immediately actionable feedback and bugs in a quick week one update. I hope this improves your experience of Dystopika. 

[h1]Release Notes - v1.0.1[/h1]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Game Console[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/f44f951bc815a8003e84e53696cc06e78a362b93.png[/img]

Introducing the Game Console! It can be accessed by pressing the ~ key (or whatever is left of the 1 on your keyboard layout).

Currently it is limited to just a few commands but I will be adding more over time.

I wanted to introduce a console to not only improve my ability to fix bugs, but also to provide faster iteration on fixing reported problems before doing a full UI integration. Here's some of the first commands. 

[b]deck[/b] - A quick macro command to force 1280x800 fullscreen on the SteamDeck in case you get locked out of the UI, which may encounter some unsupported scenarios. 

[b]music-next[/b] - skips to the next track (on shuffle)

[b]setting-vsync[/b] - force a vsync count (0,1,2,3,4). 0 is Vsync off

[b]setting-targetfps[/b] - target framerate when Vsync is 0

[b]setting-resolution[/b] - force a specific resolution and view mode

The game console is [b]EXPERIMENTAL[/b] and recommended only if you're experiencing an issue with the game. 

[h3]Experimental Branch[/h3]
There is now an Experimental Branch for early access to bug fixes. Please drop by [i]#dys_experimental[/i] in the [url=https://discord.voidswithin.com/]Discord[/url] to be notified of updates. 

[h3]New Settings[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44651138/7db3dd85ae6d62615f454ee2cf7af88f4f44f340.png[/img]
[b]Lens Dirt On/Off[/b]
Disabled Bloom Lens Dirt in build mode (can still be added in Photo Mode)

[b]Blur on Zoom On/Off[/b]
Disabled Blur effect when the camera is zoomed in and out. 

[b]Vsync replaces Target FPS[/b]
The Vsync option should better allow you to target a framerate to prevent GPU overheating. 
[list]
[*] Off = unlocked FPS
[*] Refresh Rate = target your resolution's refresh rate
[*] 1 / 2 = target HALF your resolution's refresh rate
[*] 1 / 3 = target 1/3 your resolution's refresh rate 
[*] 1 / 4 = target 1/4 your resolution's refresh rate
[/list]

If you'd like to know more of the technicals, you check out the [url=https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/QualitySettings-vSyncCount.html]Unity docs[/url]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Prop unlocks now persist across cities properly. 
[*] Billboards now have improved transparency handling for custom import images
[*] Target FPS has been replaced by a VSYNC option to potentially aid with spicy GPUs. 
[*] Certain holograms and achievements have been made less RNG-dependent. 
[*] Some tracklist adjustments have been made to Foundations soundtrack.
[*] Vertical Neon Text props now handle line breaks in the right direction
[*] Fixed a bug when the game would Save twice when clicking Quick Save
[*] The Ad Blimp now initializes random ads from the default ad pool
[*] Edit Text/Prop highlights should no longer get stuck when entering and exiting text editing. 
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] At low framerates, building movement has difficulty registering
[*] Importing the same image to different billboard sizes may result in rotated billboards
[*] Using CTRL to snap can sometimes become inverted with the UI control
[*] Light Brush neons sometimes do not save properly
[*] Some new Translations might be... off. I am currently working on a new solution for Localizations for better workflow as we get ready to expand to new languages. 
[/list]
